question: One of the first innate responses to infection is:

options.opa: T helper cells produce cytokines to promote microbicidal capacities.
options.opb: Resident macrophages produce cytokines to attract neutrophils to the infection site.
options.opc: Resident macrophages produce cytokines to attract cytotoxic T lymphocytes to the infection site.
options.opd: The dendritic cells present the microbial antigens to the neutrophils.
